name: Duplicate Row Detection
summary: Find and quantify duplicate rows in a dataset
purpose: Find and quantify duplicate rows in a dataset. Compute duplicate rate and flag datasets with excessive duplication.
assignment_instructions: You are detecting duplicate rows in a dataset. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "dataset_duplicate_detection_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - total_rows (integer) - unique_rows (integer) - duplicate_rows (integer) - duplicate_rate (number between 0 and 1): duplicate_rows / total_rows - duplicate_subset_columns (list of strings or null): columns used for subset duplicate check, or null if full-row - sample_duplicate_keys (list): up to 10 examples of duplicate keys/rows Compute duplicate_rate exactly as duplicate_rows / total_rows. Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. Include the formula in calculations array. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
